content: Xoossay Yohaannisa Bare Kawutethaa Oydiyaa Sintha Aheedda

Hewaappe guyyiyan, taani saluwan dooya penggiyaa be7aaddi; qassi taw malakataadan odishshin, taani siseedda koyro kooshshay taana; “Hawaappe guyyiyan, hananaw bessiyaawaa taani neena bessana; haa kesa” yaageedda.
Ellekka taani Geeshsha Ayyaanaa mooduwaa giddo gelaa aggaaddi. Be7ite, saluwan kawutethaa oydii de7ee; he oydiyan ittu utteedda.
He utteeddawaa malay al77o Iyaasiphphiidiyaa shuchchaadaaninne al77o Serddinoone shuchchaadaani phoolee. Kawutaa oydii zuluwaan yuuyyi aadhdhiide ubba bagganna al77o marggidiyaa shuchchaadan phoolee.

He kawutethaa oydiyaa yuuyyi aadhdhiide, hara laatamanne oyddu kawutethaa oydatuu de7iino; unttunttun bootha mayuwaa mayyiide, huuphiyaan worqqaa akililiyaa wotheedda laatamanne oyddu cimatuu utteeddino.
Kawutethaa oydiyaappe walqqanthay, kooshunchchaynne guugunthaa gunthay keseedda; qassi kawutethaa oydiyaa sinthan laappu xomppatuu poo7iino. Hewanttu Xoossaa laappu ayyaanatuwa.

Kawutethaa oydiyaa sinthan birilliya malatiyaa burccukkuwaa abbay de7ee. He kawutethaa oydiyaappe sinthannanne guyyenna A matan yuuyyi aadhdhiide, ayfi kumeedda oyddu de7uwan de7iyaa medhetatuu de7iino.
Koyro de7uwan de7iya medhetay gaammuwaa malatee; laa7enthuu miizzaa maraa malatee; heezzenthuwaa som77i asaa deemuwaa malatee; qassi oyddenthuu paalliyaa argganthaa malatee.
Oyddu de7uwan de7iya medhetatoo huuphiyaan huuphiyaan usuppun qefii de7ee; unttunttoo bollan garssankka ubbasan ayfi kumeedda. Unttunttu qammanne gallassi,
He medhetatuu kawutethaa oydiyan utteedda medhi medhinaw de7uwan de7iyaawaa mazimuriyan sabbeedda wode, bonchcheedda wodenne galateedda wode,
laatamanne oyddu cimatuu kawutethaa oydiyan utteedda medhi medhinaw de7iyaawaa sinthan guufanniide, aw goyinniino; barenttu akililiyaa kawutethaa oydiyaa sinthan wothiide hawaadan yaagiino.
